question.nlq: I would like to know the three customers who have spent the greatest total amount on products whose order items were delivered, including each customer's full name, email address, total amount spent, and the date of their most recent delivered order.

meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT
    (c.customer_first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(c.customer_middle_initial || ' ', '') || c.customer_last_name) AS full_name,
    c.email_address,
    SUM(p.product_price) AS total_amount,
    MAX(o.date_order_placed) AS most_recent_delivered_order
FROM Customers c
JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE oi.order_item_status_code = 'Delivered'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

turns.sql:
WITH delivered_items AS (
    SELECT oi.order_id, p.product_price
    FROM Order_Items oi
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE oi.order_item_status_code = 'Delivered'
),
customer_spend AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           SUM(di.product_price) AS total_spent,
           MAX(o.date_order_placed) AS most_recent_order_date
    FROM Orders o
    JOIN delivered_items di ON o.order_id = di.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
customer_info AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.customer_first_name || ' ' ||
              CASE WHEN c.customer_middle_initial IS NULL OR c.customer_middle_initial = '' THEN ''
                   ELSE c.customer_middle_initial || ' ' END ||
           c.customer_last_name AS full_name,
           c.email_address,
           cs.total_spent,
           cs.most_recent_order_date
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN customer_spend cs ON c.customer_id = cs.customer_id
)
SELECT full_name, email_address, total_spent, most_recent_order_date
FROM customer_info
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 3;

question.nlq: Could you show me the top three customers by total spend, where total spend is the sum of product_price for all delivered order items, and also include each customer's email address and the number of distinct orders they have placed?

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH spend AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           SUM(p.product_price) AS total_spend
    FROM Order_Items oi
    JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE oi.order_item_status_code = 'Delivered'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
order_cnt AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
    FROM Orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT c.email_address,
       spend.total_spend,
       order_cnt.order_count
FROM spend
JOIN order_cnt ON spend.customer_id = order_cnt.customer_id
JOIN Customers c ON spend.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY spend.total_spend DESC
LIMIT 3;

turns.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.email_address,
       SUM(p.product_price) AS total_spend,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM Customers c
JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE oi.order_item_status_code = 'Delivered'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.email_address
ORDER BY total_spend DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.email_address,
       SUM(CASE WHEN oi.order_item_status_code='Delivered' THEN p.product_price ELSE 0 END) AS total_spend,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM Customers c
JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
LEFT JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.email_address
ORDER BY total_spend DESC
LIMIT 3;
